hypothesis: An explicitly supervised discrete carry register permits length-independent composition of learned local transitions. No assumption of connectome advantage.
selection: Use train and length 2-4 validation only; freeze confirmation budget and code hashes before final evaluation.
supervision_difference: Discrete has explicit carry labels and exhaustive 860 local states; continuous learns output digits on 4800 short sequences without carry labels. This is an architectural-and-supervision comparison, not an isolated memory ablation.
primary_metrics: whole-answer exact match by operation and length
inference: No answer oracle. Optional cache contains only model predictions. Direct inference parity checked separately.
